name: The Horde Needs Purple Lotus!
label: Quest
description: The Horde Needs Purple Lotus!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The purple lotus, adventurer, is a reagent in a great many potions, elixirs and oils, some of which will be of use to us at Ahn'Qiraj. We're going to need to create an immense number of those potions for the war effort. And I'm going to experiment to find more uses for the lotus as well. But to do all of that I'm going to need a great quantity of the flower.
That's where you come in. Go out into the field and collect up as many purple lotuses as you can. Is this something that you are willing to do for us?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Returned already with the purple lotus that I have requested, adventurer? It is critical that you do so in as timely as fashion as possible lest all that I am attempting here come to naught.

clips.title: Completion
paras: A commendable effort, adventurer. I will measure these specimens for their appropriate usage and note your contribution. The purple lotus will then need to be properly stored until I am ready for them. As for you, if you are still available I should imagine that I'll still need more purple lotus. Please check back with me in a moment.
